card.name: Words leading into thresholds or conditions
card.fires_on: Linking words or comparison words just before a threshold, time gap or result, such as 'greater' or 'more than' before a number, or 'until' before a target. Mostly in drug-label monitoring and dose-adjustment text.

modes.label: Comparison before a number
modes.description: Words like 'greater' or 'than' that lead into a numeric limit or time gap.
modes.example: separate dosing by more<< than>> 2 hours from bosutinib

modes.label: Condition or continuation words
modes.description: Words such as 'until' or 'concomitantly' that lead into a condition or the next clause.
modes.example: Monitor<< until>> weight returns to more than 90

modes.label: Non-label prose
modes.description: Occasional connecting words in general text that lead into an outcome or action.
modes.example: open ranks<< and>> let them pass
